mishkefet.preprocess_pipeline: _contrast_normalize (p1..p99 clip when span >= 30) -> proportional resize to LINE_HEIGHT=64 (pad/cap width) -> continuous float32 inkness 1.0 - gray/255.0
mishkefet.training_augment_summary: Augment._stroke() is strictly inside training-only Augment.__call__ (p=0.50: 72% erode k=2..3 at 0.3..1.0 blend, 28% dilate k=2 at 0.3..0.6 blend); never invoked by Recognizer or preprocess()

kraken.transforms_summary: L/RGB conversion -> CenterNormalizer (1-ch) or pil_fixed_resize (3-ch PP-OCRv6) -> white pad 255 -> float [0,1] tensor_invert; no stroke-width normalization or binarization
